modules.title: Believers' Class
modules.cardText: Start here if you're new in the faith - the fundamentals of the new birth, baptism, prayer, and Christian living.
modules.heroText: Learn the foundational doctrines every believer needs - the New Birth, Quiet Time, Baptism, and the Second Coming - one study at a time.

modules.title: Baptismal Class
modules.cardText: A deeper 15-study journey preparing you for water baptism, covering doctrine, conduct, and spiritual disciplines.
modules.heroTitle: Prepare your heart for the waters of baptism
modules.heroText: A deeper walk through doctrine, conduct, and spiritual discipline - for those getting ready to be buried with Christ in baptism and raised to walk in newness of life.

modules.title: Workers-in-Training
modules.cardText: For those stepping into service - church structure, conduct among workers, gifts, and ministry administration.
modules.heroTitle: Equipped to serve in the house of God
modules.heroText: For those stepping into service - church structure, conduct among workers, spiritual gifts, and ministry administration in the RCCG.
